name: degree_centrality
author: 62a230f4
description: Ranks nodes by degree centrality: degree divided by n-1. Use for questions about the most connected people or the airports with the most direct routes. Works on directed and undirected graphs. On a directed graph it also returns in_score and out_score. Returns the top_k nodes with scores. Optional mode 'in' or 'out' ranks by incoming or outgoing degree instead of total.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse.

top_k.description: How many top nodes to return.

mode.description: Ranking key: total (default), in, or out. On undirected graphs in and out match total.
